caption:
The video captures a close-up view of a black helical coil spring standing vertically between a cylindrical metal press head above and a hexagonal metal base platform below, set against a mottled gray concrete wall. A small yellow label marks the right edge of the base. The head is already close to the top coil.

As the action proceeds, the cylindrical head descends gradually, its lower edge moving from just above the top coil toward the compressed stack. The spring shortens as the gaps between its turns shrink until the coils close together. As compression advances, the upper coils lean slightly to the right while the lower coils spread outward. The base and wall stay in place, so the visible change is the head's descent and the spring's compression.

By the last visible moment the coil stack is heavily compressed and the head is close to it, while the turns remain partly separated and the process is still not visibly settled into a finished state within view.
relations: The descending cylindrical head presses the top coil, shrinking gaps between turns as compression advances.
As coils close, upper turns lean slightly right while lower turns spread outward against the hex base.
The base platform and concrete wall remain fixed, so visible change is confined to head descent and spring shortening.
By the final moment the stack is heavily compressed yet turns remain partly separated, still mid-process.
